items.textToSpeech: For everyone aged 7+ months, including those pregnant or lactating, the Adequate Intake for linoleic acid is 4% of energy intake. So for example, for a daily energy intake of 2,000 kilocalories, the Adequate Intake is 80 kilocalories from linoleic acid per day. Linoleic acid cannot be synthesised by the body, is required to maintain “metabolic integrity”, and is therefore an essential fatty acid.

The Adequate Intake is the average observed or experimentally determined approximations or estimates of nutrient intake that is assumed to be adequate. For the European Union, Dietary Reference Values are published by the European Food Safety Authority Panel on Dietetic Products, Nutrition and Allergies. Is there anything else I can help you with?
